name: Throwmod
description: Pick up and throw other players. With nothing in your hand, click a player no bigger than you to lift them, limp, into your arms; click again to throw them where you look. You can only lift players in a minigame with weapon damage, or a bot from your own bot brick. While carrying you cannot jet. Our own version of Nobot's Script_Nobotthrowmod for Blockland.
